lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition MgAlMn2 (32 atoms per cell, Mg8Al8Mn16) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216). Its unit cell contains four independent Wyckoff orbits, with Al and Mg each adopting an 8-neighbor body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while Mg also shows a 16-neighbor close-packed-like environment and Mn has 12 geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and face-sharing between Al and Mn polyhedra, corner-sharing between Mg and Mn, and edge-sharing between like Al and like Mg polyhedra.
